description: Round 2, free part. Once the full report is unlocked and the host or company has answered, send their reply (pasted text and/or up to 4 screenshots). neatly checks it against every point raised and returns which points they answered, partly answered or ignored, any new amount, and how much new evidence they sent. Ask the user before sending their files. The detailed notes and the next reply come with unlock_round2.

reply_text.description: Their reply, pasted as text. Optional if you send screenshots

report_url.description: The report link or its id

screenshots.description: Screenshots of their reply, as https links or base64

data_base64.description: The image as base64, instead of a url

url.description: Public https link to the image

name: check_their_reply
title: Round 2: check their reply
